FULL TEXT:
CENTRE FOR HUMAN RIGHTS & DUTIES
(1st Floor Emerging Areas Building, Sector-14)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF PROJECT COORDINATOR
Project: Socio-Psychological Impacts of Drug Addiction on the Wives of the Addicts: A Study
of Majha Region in Punjab
Sponsoring Agency: National Commission for Women, New Delhi
Designation: Project Coordinator (01)
Requirements for Project Coordinator
Essential: - Applicants are required to have done Master’s Degree in Social Sciences or Law and
must be pursuing/hold Ph.D. in Social Science sor Law with minimum 55% marks.
Desirable: Experience in data collection, data entry through SPSS, analysis report writing, etc.
Candidate must be well versed with the research methodology.
Work Description: Prospective Project Coordinators required to assist in the project work, field
visits and data collection and analysis using techniques of statistics.
Honorarium:Project Coordinators entitled to Rs. 18,000/ per month (Fixed).
Duration: The duration shall be of 9 months or till the completion of the project whichever is
earlier. The Project Coordinator may be terminated even before (with one week notice if the
work is not found satisfactory).
Domain for Data Collection: Punjab (Amritsar, Gurdaspur, TaranTaran)
How to apply
Applications on plain paper giving following details must reach the undersigned by 01.07.2023.
Full Bio-data including name, parents name, postal address, email and mobile number along with
academic details starting from 10th onwards and experience as well as supporting documents.
Application as a single PDF file can also be sent by email to projectpunjab2023@gmail.com
 Hard copy can be brought at the time of interview, incase application is sent through
email.
(Namita Gupta)
Professor and Principal Investigator of the Project
Centre for Human Rights and Duties
